name: Curse of Galvanism
description:
You are far more likely to be struck by lightning during thunderstorms.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 1❤️[/dark-red] to incur Ythogtha's wrath. His eye appears above you and slowly opens, after which a powerful lightning strike occurs at your location, dealing 10❤️ damage in a large radius.
